sequence.subject: The grocery bagger in Playa del Carmen
paragraphs: On a trip to Playa del Carmen, a friend who lives there walked me through a local grocery store and explained something I would never have found on my own. The baggers work for free. They are senior citizens who volunteer so that shoppers' tips become their income, a quiet program that keeps elders engaged and supported.
That moment showed me the difference between recommending a place and standing inside it. It is why I build trips around relationships with the people who live there.
If you have a moment like that from your own travels, I would love to hear it. Reply and tell me about it.
sequence.ps: The thinking behind this is on the philosophy page: https://consciouscreator.app/philosophy

sequence.subject: Three questions for your next local partner
paragraphs: A good relationship starts with a good question. Here are three from the starter guide that you can use this week:

ol: What do you most want a guest to understand before they arrive?
How do you work with people in your community, and how can guests support them?
Who else in your community do you trust and recommend?

paragraphs: Write the answers in their words, and ask before you share them. If you try one, reply and tell me what you learned.
sequence.ps: A look inside five days built around this way of working: https://consciouscreator.app/look-inside

sequence.subject: Five days in Akumal and Tulum
paragraphs: In February 2027, fifty travel advisors will spend five days in Akumal and Tulum, February 8 to 12.

A private villa with onsite chefs. A private catamaran day along the reef. Four cenotes, zip lines, and a Mayan village with Living Dreams Mexico. The Sian Ka'an Biosphere by freshwater channel. And hands-on workshops with Nathan Riddle and Kha Ly on storytelling and publishing in your own voice.

Everything in the seat is included, and optional extras are available on request. Seats are selected by application. If it sounds like a fit, I would be glad to read yours: https://consciouscreator.app/apply

sequence.subject: Is it a fit?
paragraphs: Selection is intentionally narrow, and it reads for purpose. It may be a fit if:

ul: You are a travel advisor or agency owner with real intent to build authority in your own voice.
You are willing to do creative work in destination: capture, edit, post, refine.
You believe relationships with local people make a better client experience.
You can say why you want this education and how you will apply it.
You arrive with humility and curiosity.

paragraphs: If that sounds like you, tell us who you serve and what you are building: https://consciouscreator.app/apply
Whether or not you apply, I am glad you are here.
